insert_OpenSearchClient: insert vector items into an OpenSearch collection with text, metadata, and embedding vectors
upsert_OpenSearchClient: upsert vector items into an OpenSearch collection using doc_as_upsert for existing or new documents
search_OpenSearchClient: search an OpenSearch collection by embedding vector using cosine similarity and return ranked results
delete_collection_OpenSearchClient: delete all documents in an OpenSearch collection by filtering on collection name
reset_OpenSearchClient: reset by deleting all OpenSearch indexes matching the configured index prefix
